system.summary: unknown for these items: no ciphertext seen. Family: the conspirators' book ciphers (page-line-word on Price Collier 1914; an 1880 German-English dictionary), broken by Riverbank 1917-18.
system.notes: symbol_kind is a placeholder (the family uses numbers); nothing about these items' system is confirmed.

prior_solution.where: Sibling messages read by the British and by Riverbank (Friedman) for the 1917 Chicago and 1917-18 San Francisco trials; Chakravarty extracts in the OG 1396 British digest; telegram substance in CPI 1918 p. 52

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue task; no other input.

solution.what: Web search on Friedman / Hindu conspiracy / Gupta cipher letter: Riverbank break of the Chicago letters (Collier 1914) and the SF messages (1880 dictionary) found; nothing on 10020-87 or the undeciphered telegram. NSA Friedman lectures not readable by script (403).
M1194 cards (roll 91 f.0195, roll 3 f.0487) viewed: 10020-87 cipher letter of 7 Nov 1917, no solution; the letter itself is not filmed.
M1085 roll 760 f.0285-0286 viewed: CPI pamphlet pp. 51-52; the telegram is a 1916 Chakraberty->Zimmermann telegram in substance only, no ciphertext.

OG 1396 found filmed on M1085 rolls 284-285; catalogue OCR (parts 284A, 284B, 285C) grepped: British digest with Chakravarty message extracts and 'Dr. C's draft cipher message of May 1916'; no target ciphertext in the OCR'd parts. About 3,000 frames without OCR unviewed.

outcome.notes: No ciphertext reached yet. Identified the telegram's source (CPI German Plots and Intrigues p. 52, Chakraberty->Zimmermann 1916) and that OG 1396 is filmed on M1085 rolls 284-285. Next: view the unOCR'd OG 1396 frames; College Park for 10020-87.
